reasons.text: The legible label photo shows model B0726Y, which is a recalled model, so the model is confirmed.
The date code on the label is 8/22, which is after the recalled range of August 2021 (8/21) or earlier, so the helmet is not within the recall.
The destruction photo does not show the required destruction (cutting off the straps); the product appears intact. This is an additional deficiency.
Retailer (Fred Meyer) and purchase date (2023-10-31) are within the listed retailers and sale window, and there are no duplicate claims, so those checks do not change the outcome.
